name: spotify-discord-stats
description: Spotify listening stats on your Discord profile widget, plus weekly and monthly recap DMs. Runs on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.cf:d1:migrate:local: node scripts/cf.js d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:remote: node scripts/cf.js d1 migrations apply DB --remote

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Your Discord bot token: [Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications) → your app → **Bot** → **Reset Token**. The app ID and your user ID are read from it, and the bot DMs you the sign-in link for the admin page.
